create.description: A calendar of your own, or one of a constellation you manage.
create.ownerHint: Constellation calendars can be created by admins and owners of the constellation.

permissions.description: What people may do with their own events and what constellation members get by default.
permissions.roleDefaultsHint: What members of the owning constellation get, by their role in the constellation.

sharing.description: People and constellations who get access beyond the defaults.
sharing.addDescription: With someone from one of your constellations, or with a whole constellation you are in.
sharing.pickSomeone: Pick a person or constellation first.

errors.grantExists: This person or constellation already has access. Change their level in the list instead.

groups.title: Constellations
groups.description: Partners, metamours and chosen family you share calendars with.
groups.emptyText: Create a constellation for your partners, metamours and chosen family, then invite people by email or link.
groups.frozenHint: This constellation is over its plan limit: role changes and new members are paused until it is back within the limit. Removing members still works.
groups.notFoundText: This constellation does not exist, or you are not a member (any more).

roleHints.owner: Everything, including roles, billing and deleting the constellation
roleHints.member: Sees the members and adds to constellation calendars

members.hidden: Only members, admins and owners can see the member list of this constellation.

roleDialog.description: Roles decide what someone may do in the constellation and its calendars.

revokeShares.hint: Removes event permissions given to {name} personally in this constellation's calendars. Uncheck to keep them.
revokeShares.selfHint: Removes event permissions given to you personally in this constellation's calendars. Uncheck to keep them.
revokeShares.demoteHint: Also removes event permissions given to {name} personally in this constellation's calendars. Uncheck to keep them.

removeDialog.description: {name} loses access to the constellation and its calendars. You can invite them again later.

leaveDialog.description: You lose access to the constellation's calendars. To come back, you need a new invitation.

transferDialog.description: Their plan will govern the constellation from now on (limits like members per constellation). You stay an owner.

errors.lastOwnerLeave: You are the only owner. Make another member an owner before you leave, or delete the constellation.
errors.frozen: This constellation is over its plan limit, so roles can't change and nobody can join right now. Removing members still works.
errors.forbidden: Your role in this constellation doesn't allow this.
errors.hasCalendars: This constellation still owns calendars. Delete them or move them to someone else first.

settings.title: Constellation details
settings.readOnly: Only admins and owners can change the constellation details.
settings.billingText: The billing owner's plan governs this constellation's limits.
settings.leaveText: You lose access to the constellation's calendars.
settings.dangerText: Deletes the constellation, its memberships and invitations for everyone. The constellation's calendars must be deleted or moved first.
settings.deleteConfirm: This can't be undone. Type the constellation name to confirm.

invite.description: Join the constellation to see and edit its shared calendars.
invite.expiredText: The invitation is invalid, has expired, was revoked or was already used. If you already joined, you find the constellation under Constellations. Otherwise ask for a new invitation.
invite.unverifiedText: To join constellations, confirm {email}. Open the link we sent you, then come back to this page.
invite.frozenTitle: This constellation can't take new members right now
invite.frozenText: The constellation is over its plan limit. Ask the constellation's owner to free up space, then try again.

code.billing_owner_must_be_owner: The billing owner must be an owner of the constellation.
code.external_sharing_not_allowed: Sharing outside the constellation is not allowed for this calendar.
code.group_frozen: This constellation is read-only because the plan limit was exceeded.
code.group_has_calendars: Delete or move the constellation's calendars first.
code.last_owner: A constellation needs at least one owner.

add.title: Add a person or constellation
add.whoPlaceholder: Choose a person, constellation or everyone

violations.duplicate_principal: This person or constellation is listed twice.
violations.group_not_selectable: You can only choose constellations you belong to or that already have access to the calendar.
violations.user_not_selectable: You can only choose people who share a constellation or this calendar with you.

benefit.owned_groups: Several constellations? Pro lets you own more of them.
benefit.members_per_group: Your constellation is growing. Pro has room for many more members per constellation.
